title: Unique Roasted Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A crowd-pleasing Turkish dish featuring coriander leaves and infused oil, this recipe is a low-calorie-friendly option for any occasion. The combination of roasted lamb and spices creates a chewy and flavorful experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the lamb in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until browned on all sides.
Remove the lamb from the oven and brush with lemon juice.
Return the lamb to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.
